scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc && cp -r src/_locales src/manifest.json src/popup.html src/popup.css src/board.html src/board.css src/options.html src/options.css dist/ && node scripts/inject-env.mjs
scripts.e2e:ensure-build: test -d dist -a -f dist/manifest.json || (echo 'e2e requires dist/ with a built extension; running build first…' && npm run build)
scripts.e2e: npm run e2e:ensure-build && npx playwright test --config playwright.config.js
